name: Volcano coordinates by Global Volcanism Program number
description: A lookup from Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program volcano number (vnum) to position, used to place USGS volcanic alert notices on the globe. The USGS elevated-volcano feed reports vnum, name and alert level but carries no coordinates, so only position is taken from here; the volcano's name and alert level always come from the live USGS notice.
license_note: Wikidata is released under CC0 1.1 (public domain dedication). Volcano numbers are the Smithsonian Institution Global Volcanism Program's identifiers (property P1886).
build: SPARQL against query.wikidata.org for every item with a GVP volcano number (P1886) and coordinates (P625), keeping one row per vnum and preferring rows that carry a name and an elevation. Where several Wikidata items share a vnum the chosen point can be a named vent rather than the summit (vnum 332010 resolves to a Kilauea vent about 10 km from the caldera), which is within tolerance for placing an alert marker at globe scale.
